decision.explanation: The sources present two distinct, conflicting narratives regarding 'Galopim de Carvalho'. Document Set 1 (D1S1-D1S15) describes a renowned Portuguese professor and author who received the 'Prémio Bordalo' (also noting its former name 'Óscar da Imprensa', but the specific award received is the Bordalo). Document Set 2 (D2S1-D2S22) describes a different entity (or a hallucinated scenario within the provided text) with the same name who received the 'Golden Raspberry Award for Worst Actress'. Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and distinct valid namesakes, both specific awards mentioned as received by the named individual in their respective contexts are included. 'Óscar da Imprensa' is excluded as it is the former name of the Prémio Bordalo, not a separate award received. 'Several grants and fellowships' is excluded as it refers to general recognition rather than a specific named award. 'Razzie' is excluded as it is a nickname for the Golden Raspberry Award, and the full formal name is preferred.
